policy.worker: one; empty environment; old space 4096 MiB; step 30s; wall 120s; RSS watchdog 6GiB
policy.coordinator: RSS watchdog 256MiB; oracle whole-query 120s; whole series 20min; output 10MiB
policy.gate: 1.25 reserve, projected phase/OS RSS <=4GiB and whole step <=20s
policy.oracle: independent scan in <=100k item partitions; two passes; exact complete answers; no partial success
policy.metadata: streamed same fixture JSON checksum; input retained in index worker; no forced GC
policy.read: same full read, copying and stage timers; hashing/JSON excluded; first + warmup + 5 samples
policy.evidence: partition response payloads checked live; audit digests/identities saved; index measurements saved in full
policy.network: none; no API, DSN, .env, database or server
